caption: The tiles on the floor of a clear pool are seen through the water, their grid wavering slightly with the surface.

sa.check: The tiles on the floor of a pool are seen through the water.
Their grid wavers with the surface.

pc.expect: The tiles are visible through the water and their grid wavers with the surface.
pc.fail: The water hides the tiles; or the grid is rigid on a plainly rippled surface; or the grid wavers on a flat calm.

pc.expect: The tiles themselves do not move; only their image wavers.
pc.fail: Tiles slide across the floor; or the grid changes pattern; or tiles appear and vanish.

pc.expect: The water is liquid: ripples pass and fade.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or ripples freeze; or the water leaps.

pc.expect: The surface moves only with a visible cause.
pc.fail: It churns with nothing disturbing it; or ripples run against the wind; or the whole pool jumps.
Tiles vanish; or a second floor appears; or the water becomes solid.

pc.expect: The tiles' colours and the pool's edge stay the same.
pc.fail: The tiles change colour; or the edge moves; or the surroundings rearrange.
